title: handoff-index-drift.py is blind to a status desync between the index and the record
description: The hook compares handoff EXISTENCE and disk status, never the index entry's status against the record file's. So the class of drift found on 2026-08-19 - 10 files still saying `open` after the index recorded them superseded, and MPI-325's entry saying `open` while its own file carried the closure note - is invisible to it. It rotted for six days after a refresh that had just cleaned the same list. Add the third comparison. Evidence and the repair that was applied by hand: brief.md, commit 908343a0.
